answer.rationale: Competitor price pressure creates urgency, but exp_73 shows targeted discounting acquired cohorts with -12% 30-day retention—unsustainable. Instead, leverage proven interventions: activation_messaging (memory_91) improved week-one engagement and drove first meaningful actions, addressing churn risk by deepening product engagement before renewal conversations happen. Pair with onboarding simplification (memory_86: +13% completion, +3% retention) to compress time-to-value—existing customers gain faster ROI, reducing price sensitivity. Referral incentives (memory_57) activate established customers as growth lever without acquisition cost. This avoids the retention cliff from discounting while building sustainable qualified revenue through engagement and product value. Enterprise_sales_assist reserves capacity for high-ACV deals and doesn't address SMB churn. Standard_experiment allows measured validation before broader rollout, preserving budget for next cycle verification.
